description: Knobs for the re-read-before-edit guard (reread-guard) and its read tracker (track-read). The single source for the Claude and Codex bash hooks (through lib/guard-rules.sh, generated by scripts/gen-guard-rules.py) and for the pi in-process guard.

messages.warn: reread-guard: about to edit {path} not Read this turn (warn {count}/{budget}). Read it first, or export TRELLIS_REREAD_OVERRIDE=1. Repeated FAILED stale edits will BLOCK.
messages.block: reread-guard: BLOCKED edit of {path} — it was not Read this turn and the re-read warn budget is exhausted. Read it first, or export TRELLIS_REREAD_OVERRIDE=1 to override.

edit_failure_markers.why: An edit-family tool response that is a string is an error string; one of these markers means the edit failed and must not count as a read. A Read response is file content and is never tested.
edit_failure_markers.pattern: does not match|String to replace|no changes|Error:|tool_use_error|ENOENT|not found|has not been read
